notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.1.2 - Poll: clicking a device only views it; a banner offers Connect to this device, and the current connection is kept if the new one cannot be reached. Read/Write on a device that is not connected is refused with a reason. Rejected values keep their message visible; the state shows Connected right after Stop. Slave: Listen no longer changes other devices' port or transport; only the listening endpoint shows Answering; Poll traffic is no longer counted before Listen. Updates: the status bar no longer stays on Checking for updates; on Linux the old AppImage now exits cleanly after an update.
